# Command-line reference

Enumerate an AWS account, analyse its attack paths and visualise them locally. Authorized use only: run only against accounts you have written permission to assess.

Usage: `aws-enumerator <subcommand> [options]` (or `python -m aws_enumerator`). `aws-enumerator --version` prints the version; `<subcommand> --help` the options as argparse prints them. Option names must be written in full (no abbreviations).

## Subcommands

| Subcommand | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`collect`](#aws-enumerator-collect) | Enumerate an AWS account and analyse it |
| [`analyze`](#aws-enumerator-analyze) | (Re-)run the analysis of a run or a legacy report |
| [`export`](#aws-enumerator-export) | Write findings or graph exports from analysis/graph.json |
| [`merge`](#aws-enumerator-merge) | Merge the analysed graphs of runs of different accounts (graph.json 1.1) |
| [`dashboard`](#aws-enumerator-dashboard) | Serve the dashboard locally |
| [`preflight`](#aws-enumerator-preflight) | Check the permissions the selected modules need |
| [`permissions`](#aws-enumerator-permissions) | Print the IAM policy / Kubernetes RBAC the selected modules need |
| [`modules`](#aws-enumerator-modules) | List the collector registry |
| [`package`](#aws-enumerator-package) | Zip (and optionally encrypt/sign) a run |
| [`verify`](#aws-enumerator-verify) | Check a run's digests |
| [`version`](#aws-enumerator-version) | Print the version |

## Options of every subcommand

**logging (every subcommand)**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-q`, `--quiet` | — | — | only warnings and errors on stderr; no banner |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | — | — | -v: debug logging; -vv: also botocore/urllib3 debug (logs request parameters) |
| `--log-format` | `text` \| `json` | `text` | stderr log format |
| `--no-color` | — | — | no ANSI colours (also off without a TTY or with NO\_COLOR) |
| `--log-file` | `PATH` | — | JSON-lines log file, mode 0600 (collect: &lt;run root&gt;/run.log) |

`-h`, `--help` and `--version` are accepted everywhere.

## aws-enumerator collect

Enumerate an AWS account and analyse it.

**AWS identity and regions**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile` | `NAME` | — | AWS profile (one session for the whole run) |
| `--region` | `R` | — | collect one region (also the home region) |
| `--regions` | `A,B` | — | collect these regions |
| `--all` | — | — | collect every enabled region |
| `--exclude-regions` | `A,B` | — | with --all only |

**module selection**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--modules` | `A,@GROUP` | — | modules, aliases or @groups (repeatable or comma-separated); see 'aws-enumerator modules' |
| `--skip` | `A,@GROUP` | — | modules to remove |
| `--max-tier` | `1` \| `2` | `2` | 1 drops tier-2 modules (APIs returning secret-bearing configuration) |
| `--no-k8s` | — | — | do not query the Kubernetes API of EKS clusters |
| `--k8s` | — | — | Kubernetes collection on (the default) |

**Kubernetes (on by default)**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--k8s-secrets` | — | — | list Secret metadata only (names, never values); off by default |
| `--k8s-auth` | `eks-token` \| `kubeconfig` \| `token` \| `in-cluster` | `eks-token` |  |
| `--kubeconfig` | `PATH` | — |  |
| `--kube-context` | `NAME` | — |  |
| `--k8s-token-file` | `PATH` | — |  |
| `--k8s-ca-file` | `PATH` | — |  |
| `--k8s-clusters` | `A,B` | — | only these cluster names |
| `--k8s-timeout` | `CONNECT,READ` | `5,60` |  |
| `--no-k8s-self-review` | — | — | skip SelfSubjectRulesReview |

**output**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--output` | `DIR` | — | output root (default $AWS\_ENUMERATOR\_OUTPUT, else ~/.aws-enumerator/reports) |
| `--allow-in-repo` | — | — | allow an output inside a git work tree |
| `--run-id` | `ID` | — | run id (default &lt;UTC timestamp&gt;-&lt;6 hex&gt;) |
| `--resume` | `RUN_DIR\|RUN_ID` | — | re-run the units of an existing run that did not finish cleanly |
| `--retry-denied` | — | — | with --resume: also re-run denied modules |
| `--no-analysis` | — | — | collect only (run 'aws-enumerator analyze' later) |
| `--zip` | — | — | write &lt;output&gt;/&lt;account&gt;/&lt;run\_id&gt;.zip |
| `--encrypt` | `age:RCPT\|gpg:RCPT` | — | encrypt the zip with an external tool (implies --zip) |
| `--sign` | `gpg:KEYID\|minisign:KEY` | — | detached signature of the archive (implies --zip) |
| `--redact-identity` | — | — | drop the caller ARN and user id from the manifest and logs |
| `--shutdown-grace` | `SECONDS` | `20.0` | after SIGINT/SIGTERM, how long running units may finish (default 20) |
| `--skip-global` | — | — | do not collect global services |
| `--global-from` | `RUN_DIR` | — | copy global/ from another run of the same account |

**analysis**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--baseline` | `PATH` | — | previous run or findings.json; writes analysis/diff.json |
| `--suppress` | `FILE` | — | suppression file |

**load and resilience**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--concurrency` | `N` | `3` | units (global + each region) in parallel (default 3, max 16) |
| `--max-rps` | `N` | — | cap every rate-limit bucket |
| `--rate-limit` | `SVC=RPS` | — | override one service |
| `--no-rate-limit` | — | — | disable the client-side rate limiter (labs) |
| `--retry-mode` | `legacy` \| `standard` \| `adaptive` | — | botocore retry mode (default: your config, else adaptive) |
| `--max-attempts` | `N` | — | botocore total attempts (default: your config, else 5) |
| `--deny-breaker` | `N` | `3` | consecutive per-item denials of one API before the rest are skipped (0 disables) |

**collector tuning**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--iam-mode` | `gaad` \| `per-entity` | `gaad` |  |
| `--iam-gaad-file` | `PATH` | — | import an exported GAAD JSON |
| `--no-credential-report` | — | — | skip GenerateCredentialReport |
| `--iam-user-details`, `--no-iam-user-details` | — | on | per-user keys, SSH keys, service credentials, certificates |
| `--s3-subresources` | `basic` \| `full` | `basic` |  |
| `--ecs-max-revisions` | `K` | `5` |  |
| `--ebs-share-check` | `all\|none\|cap:N` | `cap:1000` |  |
| `--lambda-versions` | — | — |  |
| `--ec2-userdata-check` | — | — | UserData presence/hash/length only |
| `--full-dns` | — | — | keep TXT/MX/SRV/CAA/SPF and private A/AAAA values |
| `--keep-sensitive-metadata` | — | — |  |
| `--scp-file` | `PATH` | — | import SCPs/RCPs |

**user agent**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--ua-app-id` | `STR` | — | botocore user\_agent\_appid (default aws-enumerator/&lt;ver&gt;/&lt;run&gt;) |
| `--no-ua-tag` | — | — | send no app id (documented red-team opt-out) |

**pre-flight**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--preflight` | — | — | probe the selected modules first; record the result |
| `--preflight-only` | — | — | run the pre-flight only; write nothing |

Mutually exclusive: `--region` / `--regions` / `--all`; `--no-k8s` / `--k8s`.

## aws-enumerator merge

Merge the analysed graphs of runs of different accounts (graph.json 1.1).

Arguments: `RUN_DIR` (one or more): two or more analysed runs (directories holding analysis/graph.json), one per account.

**options**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--output` | `DIR` | — | output root (default $AWS\_ENUMERATOR\_OUTPUT, else ~/.aws-enumerator/reports); writes &lt;output&gt;/merged/&lt;run\_id&gt;/ |
| `--run-id` | `ID` | — | run id of the merge (default &lt;UTC timestamp&gt;-&lt;6 hex&gt;) |
| `--allow-in-repo` | — | — | allow an output inside a git work tree |

## aws-enumerator dashboard

| `--port` | `PORT` | `8000` | 0-65535; 0 picks a free port (default 8000) |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | complete |
| 2 | partial (some module or the analysis did not finish cleanly; `preflight` found denials) |
| 1 | fatal |
| 64 | usage error (argparse errors included) |
| 130 | interrupted by SIGINT |
| 143 | interrupted by SIGTERM |

## Old invocations

The flag-style invocation of 0.2 is translated for one release, with a deprecation warning on stderr:

| Old | Runs as |
|---|---|
| `aws-enumerator --region eu-west-2` | `aws-enumerator collect --region eu-west-2` |
| `aws-enumerator --all` | `aws-enumerator collect --all` |
| `aws-enumerator --dashboard --port 9000` | `aws-enumerator dashboard --port 9000` |
